description: SMTP-to-msg bridge. Receives email through the UnitySVC SMTP gateway and forwards it to your HTTP endpoint as a strict `{title, body, type, format}` notification envelope (the Apprise-api `/notify` shape — a drop-in for any apprise-api, mailrise, or compatible receiver). The email subject becomes `title`, the body becomes `body`. This is a multi-channel service: the free `byok` channel forwards every message to one receiver you store once as customer secrets (`HTTP_RELAY_BASE_URL`, optional `HTTP_RELAY_API_KEY`), while the metered `plus` channel lets you route different mailboxes to different Apprise-compatible receivers under a single account — each enrollment binds its own `base_url` and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for both channels.
name: smtp-to-msg

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own HTTP receiver
